title: Q-MOVE-replication-ledger: finish the Replication Ledger's move to its own repository without breaking its OpenAlex mirror
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation tenantrepos --moved replication-ledger
**Status:** open

TENANT-REPO-1: the ledger's code still deploys from instances/replication-ledger/worker in the core (doctrine/tenant-repos.json state `moving`), so a change made only in ultrastable/replication-ledger never reaches production and the two copies must be kept equal by every change. The move was started on 2026-11-25 and backed out in the same change because .github/workflows/ledger-openalex.yml (LEDGER-KEYLESS-1) runs instances/replication-ledger/worker/openalex-mirror.mjs in the core, lands data/openalex.json on the core's main with scripts/land_data.py and redeploys; once the code lives only in the tenant repository that workflow has nothing to write to, and no credential the core's Actions hold can push to ultrastable/replication-ledger (surfaces tried in tenant-repos runs: ORG_ADMIN_TOKEN, LANE_PAT and the lane App were empty).

Do, in this order: (1) move the mirror into the tenant repository as its own workflow there (its built-in token can commit data/openalex.json to its own main; the platform's daily tenant redeploy picks up the new commit); (2) confirm instances/replication-ledger/worker equals the tenant repository's worker/ apart from nothing; (3) set state `moved`, name the repository as `source` in doctrine/topology.json and doctrine/system.json (then `python3 -m foundation system --render`), point lifecycle.json, runway.json, doctrine/knowledge-graph.json, doctrine/flows.json, the loop registry row and the detector and failure-mode probes that name instances/replication-ledger/worker at the tenant repository, remove ledger-openalex.yml from the core and the core copy last. Paths: doctrine/tenant-repos.json, doctrine/topology.json, doctrine/system.json, .github/workflows/ledger-openalex.yml, instances/replication-ledger/.

size: M

**Closing probe:** python3 -m foundation tenantrepos --check passes with the tenant in state `moved` and https://replication-ledger.ultrastable.org/api/freshness answers 200 after the first deploy from the tenant repository

**Prediction:** spec_quality >= 0.7 within 336 h (read by `python3 -m foundation specgate --report`; this item closing by its done check keeps the share of well-specified open items at or above today's reading)

**Out of scope:** changing what the Replication Ledger serves, or moving any other tenant.
